sourceNotes: Dock 与启动台／聚焦搜索图标可独立设置，选择在重启后保留
减小安装包与在线升级包体积，保留所有功能、语言和图标样式
避免未授权时的后台耳机识别触发蓝牙权限提示
修复 DNS 检测返回大量解析服务器时整批结果被拒绝的问题

en: Set Dock and Launchpad/Spotlight icons independently, with both choices preserved across restarts.
Reduce installer and online update download sizes while preserving all features, languages, and icon styles.
Avoid triggering Bluetooth permission prompts during background headphone identification when permission has not been granted.
Fix DNS detection rejecting an entire result set when many resolver addresses are returned.
